description: Defines the XSolidBrush class, a concrete implementation of a brush used for drawing filled shapes and text in a PDF-related .NET library. The class manages color properties and rendering for different frameworks (GDI, WPF, UWP).

classes.name: XSolidBrush
classes.description: Represents a solid color brush used for drawing filled shapes and text, with support for different rendering frameworks and immutability control.

methods.name: XSolidBrush
methods.description: Constructors for creating an XSolidBrush instance, either default, with a specific color, copying another brush, or internally with immutability.

methods.name: Color
methods.description: Property to get or set the brush's color, with framework-specific dirty flags to optimize rendering updates.

methods.name: Overprint
methods.description: Experimental property to enable overprint when used in PDF documents, applicable only in CMYK mode.

methods.name: RealizeGdiBrush
methods.description: Creates or updates a GDI SolidBrush object based on the current color.

methods.name: RealizeWpfBrush
methods.description: Creates or updates a WPF SolidColorBrush object based on the current color.

methods.name: RealizeCanvasBrush
methods.description: Creates a UWP CanvasSolidColorBrush for drawing in a Canvas.
